text:
Oncall-Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency breach on /v1/generate-stream (shared-gpu-pool-eu-west). incident=INC-2026-03-14-GL1. Paging on-call.
Priya: acknowledged. p95 creeping up, p99 shots to ~3.2s. Seeing "stream stalled" errors in proxy logs.
Omar: looking at node metrics: high iowait on gpu-node-12, nvme queues saturated. `iostat -xm 1 3` shows await spikes.
Ben: tail from proxy: `ERR stream-write-timeout tenant=media-ops` repeated. Also `proxy: client reset` for some streams.
Nina: checking container cgroup metrics: blkio.io_service_bytes has large write counts on container 11722 (tenant media-ops). blkio.throttle.io_service_bytes shows sustained writes ~2GB/min.
Infra-Bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/noisy-neighbor (steps: identify PID, throttle or migrate, scale pool).
Priya: quick impact assessment: ~4 customers on node-12 affected, media-ops is heavy batch-loading models right now.
Omar: top processes on node-12:
```
PID USER COMMAND
11722 mediaops python3 load_datasets.py --shard large
11760 root rsync --daemon
11800 root backup-agent
```
Ben: logs in `/var/log/proxy/stream.log` show partial-chunk retransmits and backpressure.
Nina: mitigation choices: 1) apply blkio write_bps limit 2) cordon node and migrate workloads 3) apply proxy-level rate limit for tenant.
Casey: quick safe move: throttle writes for container 11722 to 25MB/s and start live migrate to dedicated-pool-eu-1. Throttle immediate, migration ~20-40s.
Priya: go for throttle+migration. Also enable temporary per-tenant stream-rate limit (to protect others).
SupportBot: customer-impact: tenants affected: media-ops (active heavy job), ad-hub, search-lite, metrics-ingest. Noting potential brief partial streams and increased tail latencies.
Omar: applying throttle: `echo "8:16 26214400" | sudo tee /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/docker/<cid>/blkio.throttle.write_bps_device` (audit: incident=INC-2026-03-14-GL1)
Ben: started tenant migration: `rbctl migrate --tenant media-ops --dest dedicated-pool-eu-1 --tag INC-2026-03-14-GL1`
Nina: metrics: write throughput on node-12 down ~78% in last 30s, iowait dropping. p99 trending down to ~900ms. p95 ~220ms.
Casey: enabled proxy rate limit: `proxyctl set-rate --tenant media-ops --endpoint /v1/generate-stream --rps 10 --tag INC-2026-03-14-GL1` to avoid bursty reconnect storms.
Priya: statuspage note queued: "Investigating increased streaming latency in EU region; mitigation underway. Some customers may see brief interruptions."
SupportBot: notifying Account SMs for media-ops and ad-hub.
Omar: small residual errors: two tenants had partial chunking for ~12s during cutover while KV caches repopulated on destination nodes. No request body loss.
Ben: autoscale: I provisioned 1 extra GPU node as buffer (scale event se-2026-03-14-09).
Nina: keeping throttle in place for 8 minutes post-migration to let IO settle. We'll remove if p99 stays <1s for 5m.
Casey: collecting artifacts: `iostat`, `nvtop` dumps, `docker inspect` for 11722, blkio counters, rbctl logs, proxy logs. I'll attach to the incident doc.
Priya: owners: mitigation=Omar, metrics=Nina, comms=SupportBot, postmortem=Ben.
Oncall-Bot: Reminder: escalate to P1 if >10% customers or SLA errors.
Priya: p99 back under 1s now ~780ms. Marking incident -> mitigated. Starting post-incident data collection and will open dedicated incident channel for full RCA if needed. :white_check_mark:
